verifications.claim: Mauricio Pochettino has called up 27 players for the March 2026 training camp.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'U.S. Men’s National Team head coach Mauricio Pochettino will bring 27 players to the training camp'; R1 cites the announcement and lists roster with notes on additions/departures aligning to 27.
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states Pochettino called up 27 players for the March 2026 camp; R1 references the same event.

verifications.claim: The March 2026 training camp is for matches against Belgium and Portugal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March Training Camp Ahead Of Matches In Atlanta Against Top-10 Ranked Opponents Belgium And Portugal'; R1: 'friendly matches against Belgium and Portugal on March 28 and 31, 2026'; R4: 'USMNT vs. Belgium, Saturday March 28, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly link the March 2026 camp to matches vs. Belgium (March 28) and Portugal (March 31).

verifications.claim: The squad is led by team captain Tim Ream.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Captain Tim Ream'; R4: '13-Tim Ream (capt.)'; R3 lists Ream with high caps and captain role implied in context.
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently identify Tim Ream as captain of the USMNT squad.

verifications.claim: The squad is led by forward Christian Pulisic
